[Colorless] Union Gain — Attach up to 2 Metal Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.
[Metal][Metal][Colorless] Dance of the Crowned Sword 150 — During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 150 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
[Metal][Metal][Colorless] Steel Cut 200
[Metal][Metal][Metal][Colorless] Master Blade 340 — Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.
How to play a Pokémon V-UNION: Once per game during your turn, combine 4 different Zacian V-UNION from your discard pile and put them onto your Bench.
V-UNION rule: When your Pokémon V-UNION is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
